text:
maria: Kicking off a short thread to capture a proposal: "cost-aware fallback bands" for routing + multi-region tenancy + isolation. We need launch KPIs, contract exhibit ideas, and who owns the PRD sections. Quick takes.
kevin: Love the name. Idea: define three fallback bands (A/B/C) that trade latency for unit-cost. Band A: performance-first (p99 target), Band B: balanced, Band C: cost-first (best-effort). Each band has a documented fallback chain and a "fallback_budget" to bound cost surprises.
sanjay: For the PRD include infra multiplier + ops upkeep per band. Roughs: A=1.35, B=1.1, C=1.0 baseline. Also include oncall delta (small/med/large tenants) so sales can price SLA add-ons.
lisa: Customer ask to record: enterprise deals want explicit fallback guarantees and a clause that limits cross-region failover without prior approval. Also EU residency + VPC + dedicated lane requests keep coming.
noah: Runtime sketch for policy DSL that encodes bands and budget:```policy {
  id: "tenant:acme/bandA"
  band: "A"
  slo: "p99<=120ms"
  fallbacks: ["model-v1","model-small"]
  fallback_budget: "$1500/month"
  migrate_grace: "12h"
}``` This allows the router to stop falling back once budget consumed.
emma: Add regression guard rails: every fallback action must evaluate against a golden prompt set in staging. If hallucination > threshold or semantic quality drops by > 5% on eval, auto-block fallback and trigger rollback. Also emit a `regression_guard` alert to SRE/ModelOps.
oliver: Launch KPIs we should track: 1) % traffic served at band-target SLO, 2) fallback-rate (per tenant), 3) fallback_budget burn rate, 4) cross-region failover count, 5) isolation_index drift. These will feed the Console one-pager.
dom: Legal/Finance asks: define exhibit language for (a) fallback_budget billing treatment, (b) erosion window reconciliation (how we bill during parallel warmup), and (c) contract checkbox for "opt-in preflight" where customers can preview shadowed fallback outcomes before consenting. I'll draft sample clauses.
maria: Good. Proposed launch gates (v0): 1) Band defs + SLA matrix; 2) fallback_budget enforcement in router + billing hooks; 3) regression_guard integrated with eval pipeline; 4) Console telemetry + one-pager; 5) contract exhibit drafted.
kevin: Ops addition: require a simulator that consumes historical traces and reports expected budget burn and fallback frequency per band. Acceptance: simulator error < 20% vs staging canary.
sanjay: I'll run cost scenarios for small/med/large model families and include sample invoices showing fallback_budget flows.
lisa: I'll validate with top 4 enterprise customers whether fallback_budget is acceptable vs hard-slice pricing. Also confirm residency wording.
noah: I'll evolve the policy DSL RFC to include budget semantics and multi-region prefer/avoid selectors. Will post draft by Tue.
emma: Will prototype the regression_guard alert and dashboard tile and run it on 3 pilot tenants.
dom: I'll draft the exhibit and a short negotiation playbook for sales.
calendarbot: meeting created: "Fallback bands & contract exhibits" Wed 14:00 Zoom.
maria: Action list captured. I'll spin up a PRD stub and tag owners. If anyone has blockers, call them out here.
